name: threadpoint-workspace
description: ThreadPoint - Community Q&A platform built on PERN stack with database trigger enforcement

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
